groups.trace: Canonical role is separate social-role authority; backend joins actual assignment rather than storing duplicate rank. Current helper requires real actor clock, no default. Membership current uses Active and inclusive now<=paid_through, matching settlement lapsed condition now>deadline. Joining authenticates local chapter, temporal scope, whole admission and entry role requirements before fee; no-dues chooses explicit MAX. Payment can prepay from active paid-through or renew fromnow. Both use saturating days, with qualified no-extension charge atMAX recorded. Activity accrual uses explicit saturated counters; no exact-unbounded minute guarantee inferred. Whole currency/role write failures may follow earlier mutation, requiring outer transaction/catch proof before partial committed allegation.
groups.disposition: One terminal represented-state policy strengthening record; no ordinary wrap or off-by-one failure. Missing real clock returns error consistently here.
